build_accuracy_score: build a function that computes accuracy score to measure fraction of correctly classified samples
create_confusion_matrix: create a confusion matrix to evaluate classification accuracy with true and predicted label counts
test_f1_score: test the f1_score function to compute balanced F-score as harmonic mean of precision and recall
refactor_precision_recall_fscore_support: refactor precision_recall_fscore_support to compute precision, recall, F-measure and support for each class
summarize_classification_report: summarize classification report building text summary of precision, recall, F1 score for each class
